description:
Configure permissions for the staff user 'coordinator'. Log in to the Aerobridge admin panel (http://localhost:8000/admin/) as 'admin' with password 'adminpass123'. Navigate to the Users section and edit the user 'coordinator'.

Assign ONLY the following specific permissions to this user using the 'User permissions' selection box:

1. registry | aircraft | Can view aircraft
2. registry | flight plan | Can add flight plan
3. registry | flight plan | Can change flight plan
4. registry | flight plan | Can view flight plan
5. registry | flight operation | Can add flight operation
6. registry | flight operation | Can change flight operation
7. registry | flight operation | Can view flight operation
8. registry | person | Can view person

Do not assign any other permissions (such as delete permissions). Do not add the user to any groups. Save the user record when finished.
